svg.text: femtoRV32 MS3: 3-stage pipeline, single unified memory, issue every 2 cycles (C0, C1)

g.text: Bonus 4 (BRANCH_IN_ID = 1): branch / jump resolved in ID
ID_EX (load end of C1, flush on stall / squash)
write rd at end of C0 (before the ID read of C1): distance 2+ needs no forwarding
EX forwarding: single source MEM_WB (ALU result or load data), no load-use stall

svg.text: Every stage is one slot of 2 cycles. PC, ID_EX and MEM_WB load at the end of C1; instLatch, EX_MEM and the RegFile write at the end of C0. Memory: C0 always fetches, C1 always serves the Stage 1 load/store, so the structural hazard never occurs.
